title: nutty Crunchy Algerian Ground Clove Tagine
description: savory, crunchy tagine with a sweet lacquer glaze and ground cloves, great for kids and flexitarian diets

ingredients.name: ground cumin
ingredients.notes: whole spice, or ground to taste

ingredients.name: ground cloves
ingredients.notes: whole spice, or ground to taste

instructions: heat olive oil in an earthenware bowl over medium heat
add chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes
add ground cumin and ground cloves, cook for 1 minute
add chicken broth, almonds, and flour, stir to combine
bring to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes
reduce heat to low and stir in cold water
spread a thin layer of lacquer glaze over the top of the tagine
transfer the bowl to the oven and bake at 375f for 15 minutes
serve hot, garnished with chopped almonds and a drizzle of lacquer glaze
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
